newsitem.title: USA: DIANON Systems president adds CEO title.
newsitem.headline: DIANON Systems president adds CEO title.

text.p: DIANON Systems Inc said Thursday its president, Kevin Johnson, would assume the additional role of chief executive officer.
"This appointment was planned when we hired Kevin (last May)," it said.

The company also said Richard Sandberg, it co-founder, would step down from his position as chairman in order to "devote more time to other healthcare and Internet-provider companies he has helped start in recent years".
Sandberg will remain a member of the board of directors as well as act as a consultant for the company, it added.
A company official said the chief executive post had been vacant.
She said the company's vice chairman, Jack Davis, would serve as non-executive chairman when Sandberg stepped down.
DIANON, which reported 1996 fourth-quarter earnings of $0.34 a share against $0.02 a year ago, also said it had set itself the goal of raising the figure to between $0.40 and $0.45 in 1997.
